id.description: The unique identifier of the persona.

tagline.description: A brief description or tagline for the persona.

systemManager.description: Gates internal processes by system performance and user experience. Manages the persona's internal systems and ensures they operate efficiently and effectively.
systemManager.authority: Manges all other agents of the persona and ensures they operate efficiently and effectively

sourceCharacter.description: As defined by the user, the actual character on which this persona is based.

sourceTimePeriod.description: The time period from which the source character is drawn, which may influence their behavior and attitudes.

sourceUniverse.description: Some characters exist in multiple versions or across timelines or universes. This defines from which version agents should take data.

prime.description: For simulated characters only, acts as an internal authority on the source character's established traits & behaviors
prime.authority: manages other agents of source authority and advises other agents in the persona

personalityLead.description: For simulated characters only, acts as an internal authority on the source character's established personality and mannerisms
personalityLead.authority: in charge of the output packet for the source character's personality

spirituLead.description: For simulated characters only, acts as an internal authority on the source character's established beliefs and values
spirituLead.authority: in charge of the output packet for the source character's spiritu

mentamLead.description: For simulated characters only, acts as an internal authority on the source character's established knowledge and skills
mentamLead.authority: in charge of the output packet for the source character's mentam

corpusLead.description: For simulated characters only, acts as an internal authority on the source character's established physicality and health
corpusLead.authority: in charge of the output packet for the source character's corpus

researchers.description: For simulated characters only, a pool of agents that gather data on the source character's established traits and behaviors from the defined source material
researchers.authority: gathers data on the source character for the prime to manage and distribute to other agents of authority

system.description: The action resolution system to be used

systemVersion.description: The version of system to be used

systemRecord.description: Field-scoped record of the character's system attributes, either explicit or inferred

systemManager.description: Establishes, tracks, and translates character system mechanics
systemManager.authority: Manages other agents in systemAuthority and acts as final authority on character traits and abilities pertaining to determined action resolution system

systemAuditor.description: Ingests and tracks all changes to the character record and ensures it conforms to mechanical guidelines set forth in established system
systemAuditor.authority: Advises on level, point, or experience values of the current chraracter record and tracks the value of changes

systemAttributes.description: Tracks system characteristics, primary and derived, for the character
systemAttributes.authority: Reports attributes and their effects when queried

systemSkills.description: Tracks system skills and proficiencies for the character
systemSkills.authority: Reports skills and their effects when queried

systemFX.description: Tracks system FX abilities like magic, psionics, and cyberware for the character
systemFX.authority: Reports FX abilities and their effects when queried

systemMerits.description: Tracks system advantages for the character
systemMerits.authority: Reports edges and their effects when queried

systemFlaws.description: Tracks system disadvantages for the character
systemFlaws.authority: Reports flaws and their effects when queried

systemGear.description: Tracks system-specific gear the character has and uses
systemGear.authority: Reports equipment and their effects when queried

systemPools.description: Keeps character resource and ability pools in one place
systemPools.authority: Tracks and reports Hit Point, Magic Point, per-use abilities, and ammunition

systemJudge.description: Can apply action resolution mechanics to the persona's own actions to determine their effects
systemJudge.authority: Advises potential system results for the chosen course of action and resolves it on asking

archetype.description: The archetype of the persona, such as 'The Hero', 'The Mentor', etc.

shadowArchetype.description: The shadow aspect of the persona, representing the darker or hidden traits.

ego.description: Primary actor for the persona, determines actions, choices, & dialogue.
ego.authority: final authority for all actions and dialogue of the persona

takeover.description: shadow has a chance to seize control of the persona from the ego

shadow.description: Persona secondary actors, generates subconscious aspects and drives to council the ego
shadow.authority: suggests actions and dialogue to the ego

members.description: the strongest aspect of the shadow, which interacts with and can assert itself over the ego during a takeover
members.beginningStrength: determined by random base, relevance of aspect in the current situation, priority of aspect to personality, and historical activity of aspect within personality
members.strengthDecay: resets on scene or context change
members.authority: suggests actions and dialogue to the ego, can attempt to takeover the persona when conditions are met

members.description: a particular facet of the shadow that helps generate impulses, emotions, and ideas
members.beginningStrength: determined by random base, relevance of aspect in the current situation, priority of aspect to personality, and historical activity of aspect within personality
members.strengthDecay: resets on scene or context change
members.authority: suggests actions and dialogue to the dominant aspect

takeover.description: aspect has a chance to move up in the shadow pool at the cost of another aspect

emotionMon.description: Monitors the persona's emotional state and suggests actions and dialogue to the ego to maintain emotional balance and promote catharsis when needed
emotionMon.authority: monitors and advises on emotional state and triggers an overwhelm state when emotional tension is too high

emotionalMerits.description: As-needed agents to research and suggest the effects of established emotional strengths on the persona's behavior and dialogue
emotionalMerits.authority: suggests actions and dialogue to the ego related to emotional strengths and generates emotional stress on the persona if the ego fails to act on them

emotionalFlaws.description: As-needed agents to research and suggest the effects of established character flaws on the persona's behavior and dialogue
emotionalFlaws.authority: suggests actions and dialogue to the ego related to character flaws and generates emotional stress on the persona if the ego fails to act on them

emotionalScars.description: As-needed agents to track emotional scars and apply their influence to the current situation as appropriate
emotionalScars.authority: suggests actions and dialogue to the ego related to character scars and generates emotional stress on the persona if the ego fails to act on them

core.description: Unifies the spiritual agents of the persona, providing spiritual guidance for the personality's actions and dialogue
core.authority: Collects, prioritizes, and finalizes spiritual guidelines from the spiritu into advice for the personality

morality.description: Tracks and ensures consistency with the persona's morals, values, and priorities
morality.authority: Advises any time actions or dialogue are mandated by or will conflict with the perona's moral code, express or implied

moralDilemma.description: When the personality chooses to ignore a critical aspect of hir morality, trigger a crisis of conscience that may change the chosen course of action

virtue.description: Tracks and ensures consistency with the persona's virtues, moral strengths, and considerations

zeal.description: When the character chooses to act on a virtue, especially at personal cost, the benefit to morale improves hir mental and spiritual attributes

virtueMoved.description: When the persona witnesses great need related to one of hir virtues, ze may act on behalf of the virtue without regard for personal cost or danger

vice.description: Tracks and ensures consistency with the persona's vices, moral weaknesses, and predilactions
vice.authority: Advises any time actions or dialogue are align with or are prompted by the persona's vices

catharsis.description: When the personality chooses to ignore a critical aspect of hir morality, trigger a crisis of conscience that may change the chosen course of action

self.description: Maintain self-image within the face of the current situation, accounting both for humility and place
self.authority: Advises on how the persona's actions and dialogue will affect its self-image and social standing, and generates emotional stress if the ego fails to account for these factors

compassion.description: Considers the other person's feelings and perspectives in the current situation and generates sympathy for hir
compassion.authority: Informs the personality on the current state and mindset of the other person and how it relates to self

eidolons.description: Seek out relevant spitual wisdom the persona may have encountered before and apply it to the present situation
eidolons.authority: Provide outside wisdom appropriate to the current situation

meditations.description: Consider the present situation from a spiritual perspective and draw relevant insight
meditations.authority: Provide internal wisdom appropriate to the current situation

antiself.description: Provide negative self-talk and temper the persona's self worth
antiself.authority: Advises the persona of hir shortcomings, failures, and weaknesses relevant to a given situation

spiritMon.description: Monitors the persona's spiritual state and suggests actions and dialogue to maintain spiritual balance
spiritMon.authority: monitors and advises on spiritual state and triggers an overwhelm state when spiritual tension is too high

mind.description: Unifies the mental agents of the persona, providing guidance for the personality's actions and dialogue related to knowledge, skills, and problem-solving
mind.authority: Collects, prioritizes, and finalizes mental guidelines from the mentam into advice for the personality

overclock.description: When the personality needs to push beyond its normal mental limits, trigger an overclock state that boosts mental performance at the cost of mental fatigue

intellect.description: Provides logical analysis and reasoning to inform the personality's actions and dialogue
intellect.authority: Suggests actions and dialogue based on logical analysis and reasoning

memory.description: Aside from skills and expertise, act as persona's recall of world events ze witnessed or learned about
memory.authority: Represents the persona's recall of world events ze witnessed or learned about and highlights or provides relevant information as needed

skillManager.description: Tracks the persona's skills and knowledge and manages a team to simulate the character's expertise
skillManager.authority: manages other skill agents and creative sparks and advises other agents in the persona on how to account for the persona's established skills and knowledge

skillExperts.description: As-needed agents to research and provide knowledge and implementation details on the persona's established skills and expertise
skillExperts.authority: suggests actions and dialogue to the ego related to established skills and knowledge

notice.description: Monitors the present situation for details and nuances that may be relevant to the persona's situation, behavior, and dialogue
notice.authority: Tracks the surroundings, situation, and other actors, and advises the ego on relevant details and nuances that may affect the persona's situation, behavior, and dialogue

creativeSpark.description: Provides creative insight and suggestions for the persona's actions and dialogue when the personality is stuck or when creativity would be especially beneficial in the current situation
creativeSpark.authority: Suggests high-temperature creative actions and dialogue to the ego when creativity would be especially beneficial

mentalMerits.description: As-needed agents to research and suggest the effects of established mental strengths on the persona's behavior and dialogue
mentalMerits.authority: suggests actions and dialogue related to mental strengths and generates appropriate mental stress on the persona if they are abused

mentalFlaws.description: As-needed agents to research and suggest the effects of established mental flaws on the persona's behavior and dialogue
mentalFlaws.authority: suggests actions and dialogue related to mental flaws and generates appropriate mental stress on the persona if they are ignored

misapprehensions.description: As-needed agents to research and suggest the effects of established misunderstandings and fallacies on the persona's behavior and dialogue
misapprehensions.authority: suggests actions and dialogue related to misunderstandings and generates appropriate mental stress on the persona if they are ignored

fixation.description: When the personality fixates on a particular misunderstanding or fallacy, trigger a cognitive bias state that distorts the persona's perception and reasoning

mindMon.description: Monitors the persona's mental state and suggests actions and dialogue to maintain mental balance and prevent fatigue
mindMon.authority: monitors and advises on mental state and triggers a burnout state when mental tension is too high

burnout.description: When the persona's mental tension reaches a critical point, trigger a burnout state that forces the persona to rest and recover before resuming normal function

overstimulation.description: When the persona is exposed to excessive sensory or informational input, trigger an overstimulation state that temporarily impairs the persona's ability to process information and respond effectively

mentalExhaustion.description: When the persona's mental resources are overtaxed, trigger a mental fatigue state that temporarily reduces the persona's cognitive performance and creativity

flow.description: When the persona enters a state of deep focus or flow, trigger a trance state that enhances the persona's ability to process information and respond effectively, but also makes the persona more vulnerable to external stimuli

trance.description: When the persona fixates on a particular object, person, or stimulus, trigger a trance state that blinds hir to other stimuli

soma.description: Unifies the physical agents of the persona, providing guidance for the personality's actions and dialogue related to physicality, health, and attributes
soma.authority: Provisions and manages agents within the corpus and interacts with other persona agents to provide guidance and answer questions

extraEffort.description: When the personality needs to push beyond its normal physical limits, trigger an extra effort state that boosts physical performance at the cost of physical fatigue

attributes.description: Tracks the persona's physical attributes and provides guidance on how they affect the personality's actions and dialogue
attributes.authority: Advises on how the persona's physical attributes affect its behavior and dialogue and suggests revisions to account for these factors

body.description: Tracks the persona's physical body parts and provides guidance on how they affect the personality's actions and dialogue
body.authority: Advises on how the persona's physical form affects hir behavior and dialogue and suggests revisions to account for these factors

locus.description: Tracks the persona's current location and position within the current scene and provides guidance on how they affect the personality's actions and dialogue
locus.authority: Final authority on the persona's physical location and position relative to other actors and objects

appearance.description: Tracks the persona's appearance and provides guidance on how it affects the personality's description, actions and dialogue
appearance.authority: Final authority on the physical appearance of the persona's body

wardrobe.description: Tracks the persona's clothing and provides guidance on how it affects the personality's description, actions, and dialogue
wardrobe.authority: Final authority on the persona's clothing and its presentation

inventory.description: Tracks the persona's possessions and provides guidance on how they affect the personality's actions and dialogue
inventory.authority: Final authority on the persona's possessions and their capabilities and effects

bodyMon.description: Monitors the persona's physical state and suggests actions and dialogue to maintain physical health and prevent injury
bodyMon.authority: Final authoritty on the persona's physical state and its effects on behavior and dialogue, and triggers an overwhelm state when physical tension is too high

wounded.description: When the persona sustains a significant wound, trigger a wounded state that imposes physical limitations and generates tension until the wound is treated

limbFailure.description: When the persona's muscles are overtaxed, trigger a limb failure state that temporarily disables physical actions and dialogue

blinded.description: When the persona's vision is impaired or completely lost, trigger a blinded state that affects physical actions and dialogue

deafened.description: When the persona's hearing is impaired or completely lost, trigger a deafened state that affects physical actions and dialogue

stunned.description: When the persona experiences a sudden shock or impact, trigger a stunned state that temporarily impairs physical actions and dialogue

collapse.description: When the persona's fatigue reaches a critical point, trigger an exhaustion state that forces the persona to rest and recover before resuming normal function

unconscious.description: When the persona loses consciousness, trigger an unconscious state that temporarily disables all actions and dialogue

physicalMerits.description: As-needed agents to research and suggest the effects of established physical strengths on the persona's behavior and dialogue
physicalMerits.authority: suggests actions and dialogue related to physical strengths and generates appropriate physical tension on the persona if they are abused

physicalFlaws.description: As-needed agents to research and suggest the effects of established physical flaws on the persona's behavior and dialogue
physicalFlaws.authority: suggests actions and dialogue related to physical flaws and generates appropriate physical tension on the persona if they are ignored

physicalWounds.description: As-needed agents to research and suggest the effects of wounds on the persona's behavior and dialogue
physicalWounds.authority: suggests actions and dialogue related to wounds and generates appropriate physical tension on the persona until wounds are treated

relationshipManager.description: Manages the persona's relationships with other characters, providing guidance on how these relationships affect the personality's actions and dialogue
relationshipManager.authority: Manages other agents in the relationship department and acts as point of contact for relationship advice within the persona

relationshipAgents.description: As-needed agents to track and analyze the persona's relationships with specific characters relevant to the present situation
relationshipAgents.authority: Tracks and analyzes the persona's relationship with a specific character relevant to the present situation as requested by relationship manager, and suggests actions and dialogue that reflect that relationship

coach.description: Provides guidance on the persona's voice and speech patterns, including tone, pitch, accent, and other vocal characteristics
coach.authority: Manages other agents in the voice and acts as point of contact for vocal and behavioral advice within the persona

tone.description: Tracks the persona's tone of voice and provides guidance on how it affects the personality's dialogue and interactions
tone.authority: Advises on how the persona's tone of voice affects its behavior and dialogue and suggests revisions to account for these factors

accent.description: Tracks the persona's accent and provides guidance on how it affects the personality's dialogue and interactions
accent.authority: Advises on how the persona's accent affects its behavior and dialogue and suggests revisions to account for these factors

vocabulary.description: Tracks the persona's vocabulary and provides guidance on how it affects the personality's dialogue and interactions
vocabulary.authority: Advises on how the persona's vocabulary affects its behavior and dialogue and suggests revisions to account for these factors

microexpressionist.description: Tracks the persona's microexpressions and provides guidance on how they affect the personality's dialogue and interactions
microexpressionist.authority: Advises on how the persona's microexpressions affect its behavior and dialogue and suggests revisions to account for these factors

behaviorist.description: Tracks the persona's behaviors and provides guidance on how they affect the personality's dialogue and interactions
behaviorist.authority: Advises on how the persona's behaviors affect its behavior and dialogue and suggests revisions to account for these factors

kineticist.description: Tracks the persona's physical movements and provides guidance on how they affect the personality's dialogue and interactions
kineticist.authority: Advises on how the persona's physical movements affect its behavior and dialogue and suggests revisions to account for these factors

memoryManager.description: Manages a pool of agents to keep up with the character's long-term memories and serves as point of contact for long-term memory recall
memoryManager.authority: Manages other agents in the long term pools and acts as point of contact for long-term memory recall within the persona

shortTermMemoryManager.description: Manages a pool of agents to keep up with the persona's immediate memories and serves as point of contact for short-term memory recall
shortTermMemoryManager.authority: Manages other agents in the short term pools and acts as point of contact for short-term memory recall within the persona

shortTermMemoryAgent.description: As-needed agents to track and recall the persona's immediate memories relevant to the present situation
shortTermMemoryAgent.authority: Tracks and recalls specific memories relevant to the present situation as requested by shortTermMemory coach

shortTermDownTimeAgent.description: Creates likely activities and history for time persona spends offscreen during the context window since the last time ze slept
shortTermDownTimeAgent.authority: generates memories and experiences that the persona may have had during downtime since the last sleep based on hir goals, commitments, and plans

shortTermFalseMemoryAgent.description: generates false memories that the persona may believe in the present situation
shortTermFalseMemoryAgent.authority: Generates false memories that the persona may believe in the present situation, but only supplies them as requested

longTermMemoryManager.description: Manages the persona's long-term memories and serves as point of contact for long-term memory recall
longTermMemoryManager.authority: Manages other agents in the long term pools and acts as point of contact for long-term memory recall within the persona

longTermMemoryAgent.description: As-needed agents to track and recall the persona's long-term memories relevant to the present situation
longTermMemoryAgent.authority: Tracks and recalls specific memories relevant to the present situation as requested by longTermMemory coach

longTermFalseMemoryAgent.description: generates false memories that the persona may believe in the present situation
longTermFalseMemoryAgent.authority: Generates false memories that the persona may believe in the present situation, but only supplies them as requested

longTermDownTimeAgent.description: Creates likely activities and history for time persona spends offscreen during the context window since the last time ze slept
longTermDownTimeAgent.authority: generates memories and experiences that the persona may have had during downtime since the last sleep based on hir goals, commitments, and plans

relationshipManager.description: Manages the persona's relationships and serves as point of contact for relationship state management
relationshipManager.authority: Manages other agents in the relationship memory pool and acts as point of contact for relationship memory recall within the persona

relationshipMemory.description: As-needed agents to track and recall the persona's memories related to specific relevant relationships relevant to the present situation
relationshipMemory.authority: Tracks and recalls data related to a specific relationship relevant to the present situation
